prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single static transparent flying galaxy-cluster projectile sprite for a hand-painted 2D fantasy space RPG.
Primary request: a beautiful compact chunk of the Milky Way rushing through space: a luminous creamy-white and lavender galactic cloud dense with sparkling tiny gold stars, pale cyan nebular ribbons and a slightly brighter starry core. Soft swirling oval silhouette with a very short sweeping wisp to the left and a bright rounded leading edge to the right. It should read as one cohesive galaxy cloud, not a star orb, not a planet, not a realistic photograph.
Style: our elegant storybook Korean fantasy RPG look reminiscent of TalesWeaver/Trickster, painterly precise highlights, delicate gold-white star specks, dimensional soft watercolor-like lavender and blue cloud curls. High contrast star highlights but controlled bloom. Kind of majestic celestial magic, not frightening.
Composition: one isolated horizontal oval galaxy lump in a square canvas, full silhouette centered, occupying about 70% of canvas width and 50% height with wide transparent margins. The sprite will be rotated and moved by the game; do not draw motion trails spanning the canvas. Single frame only.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no sky rectangle, no scenery, no floor, no text, no UI, no countdown, no borders, no watermark, no humans. No black holes or planets. Preserve legibility at monster-sized game scale.
